XNet - Lua edition
==================

Fast, safe networking for Garry's Mod. Pure Lua: runs on any server,
nothing to compile, nothing for players to download.

Install
-------

1. Extract this zip into your server's "garrysmod" folder. You get:

       garrysmod/addons/xnet/lua/autorun/xnet.lua

2. Restart the server (or change the map).

Clients receive the file automatically, like any addon's Lua.

Check it works
--------------

In the server console:

       lua_run print(XNet.Version)

It prints the version.

Use it
------

       -- server
       XNet.Receive("shop.buy", function(ply, item, amount) end)
       XNet.Send(ply, "inventory.sync", inventory)

       -- client
       XNet.Receive("inventory.sync", function(inventory) end)
       XNet.Send("shop.buy", "weapon_ak47", 2)

Full documentation: https://github.com/exliipso/XNet

Shipping it inside your own addon: copy lua/autorun/xnet.lua into your
addon. If several addons carry it, the first one loaded wins and the rest
reuse it.

Faster on the server: the native edition (xnet-native-*.zip) adds a binary
module that encodes in Rust. Same API, same files for clients.

and NOTICE are in garrysmod/addons/xnet/; keep them when you redistribute XNet.
